A '''fourth season''' of ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' was written by [[Jon Favreau]], confirming with CinemaBlend at ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Celebration Anaheim (2022)|Celebration Anaheim]] that ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'' informed his writing for the season.<ref name="CinemaBlend" /> By [[February]] [[2023]], the season was already written.<ref name="Written">{{WebCite|url=https://ew.com/tv/jon-favreau-already-written-the-mandalorian-season-4|text=Jon Favreau says he's already written The Mandalorian season 4 to fit with Ahsoka and other shows|author=Emlyn Travis|date=2023-02-22|work=[[Entertainment Weekly Books|''Entertainment Weekly'']]|archivedate=20230222214316}}</ref> After [[StarWars.com]] announced the film [[Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu|''The Mandalorian and Grogu'']] on [[January 9]], [[2024]],<ref name="Announcement Movie">{{SW|url=news/the-mandalorian-and-grogu|text=''The Mandalorian & Grogu'' Journeys to the Big Screen}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:Deadline Hollywood|''Deadline'']] reported that season four of ''The Mandalorian'' was still in development.<ref name="Deadline S4">{{WebCite|url=https://deadline.com/2024/01/mandalorian-grogu-movie-jon-favreau-lucasfilm-1235700326|text='The Mandalorian & Grogu': Jon Favreau To Direct And Produce 'Star Wars' Pic For Lucasfilm|date=2024-01-09|work=[[Wikipedia:Deadline Hollywood|''Deadline'']]|archivedate=20240109174536}}</ref>

However, [[Din Djarin]] body double [[Brendan Wayne]], when asked if a season four was coming, stated on [[March 6]], 2024, that he was unsure. All Wayne was certain of was that the movie was in the pipeline, although he believed it was for the best for [[Disney+]] to continue with season four.<ref name="Brendan Wayne interview">{{YouTube|video=VOu2OZBxtHc|text=The Mandalorian is here! Brendan Wayne Interview!|channel=chatooineshow|name=Chatooine Show}}</ref>

In an interview to [[Wikipedia:Empire (magazine)|''Empire'']] released in [[November]] [[2025]], Favreau said that he still has season four waiting on his desk, and that the movie is structured differently.<ref name="On Desk">{{WebCite|url=https://comicbook.com/tv-shows/news/the-mandalorian-season-4-plans-whether-itll-still-happen-addressed-by-creator-ahead-of-new-star-wars-movie/|text=The Mandalorian Season 4 Plans & Whether It'll Still Happen Addressed By Creator Ahead Of New Star Wars Movie|date=2025-11-20|archiveurl=https://archive.md/qVbF2}}</ref>
